# Teach grouped stack drag in the dock guides and link their parts

## Context

Found while resolving the Dock Layouts guide-series epic (`#17540`, closed after its nine subs merged). Two gaps outlived it, and no open ticket covers either.

## The Problem

- **Grouped drag is advertised and never taught.** `learn/guides/uibuildingblocks/DockLayouts.md` lists "grouped drag" among the dock's features, and `DockLayoutsAdoption.md` promises it under "Part 3 — The Feature Set". No guide says what it is, how an app enables it, or what the drop commits.
- **The adoption guide still points at the series by its plan names.** Its "Where to go next" lists "Part 2 — The Mechanics", "Part 3 — The Feature Set" and "Part 4 — Panes Are Ordinary Components" as unlinked text, while the guides that shipped go unmentioned.

## The Architectural Reality

- Grouped drag is opt-in: `Neo.dashboard.dock.projection.LayoutAdapter` takes `enableStackDrag` (default `false`) and decorates `WorkspaceDocument.resolveStackRoot(model)` with one whole-stack grip, passed as `stackHandle` from `projection/Reconciler.mjs`.
- The shipped consumers enable it only on popup workspaces — `apps/workstation/view/PopupWorkspace.mjs#getDockProjectionOptions` and the popup workspace in `examples/dashboard/crossWindow/DemoBWorkspace.mjs` — so what users meet is a popup's whole stack dragged back as one unit, committing `transferNode` (ADR 0029 §2.4).
- Witnesses already exist: `test/playwright/unit/dashboard/DockCrossWindowParticipation.spec.mjs` ("whole-stack drop") and the grouped gesture in `test/playwright/e2e/workstation/WorkstationFiveBeatNL.spec.mjs`.
- The shipped series, per `learn/tree.json`: `DockLayoutsAdoption`, `DockLayoutsStateAndPersistence`, `DockLayoutsPanes`, `DockLayoutsWindows`, `DockLayoutsStyling`, `DockLayoutsMechanics`, `DockLayoutsFeatures` (under `guides/uibuildingblocks`), `guides/testing/DockLayoutsTesting`, and `tutorials/DockLayoutsFirstLayout`.

## The Fix

1. `DockLayoutsWindows.md` gains a short section on the whole-stack return: how a workspace enables `enableStackDrag`, what the grip moves, and what `transferNode` commits, written against the running cross-window example.
2. `DockLayoutsAdoption.md` "Where to go next" links the shipped guides in place of the plan names.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A dock guide explains grouped stack drag — enabling it, what the grip moves, what the drop commits — verified against the running cross-window example.
- [ ] `DockLayoutsAdoption.md` "Where to go next" links the shipped guides; no unlinked "Part N" names remain.
- [ ] The guide-authoring bar holds for the changed guides (rendered and checked in the portal).

## Out of Scope

- New guides, and any change to grouped drag itself.

## Related

- #17540 — the guide-series epic these gaps outlived.
- ADR 0029 §2.4 — grouped drag, `moveNode` / `transferNode`.
